ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution with a ratio approximately 95:5 of dark to high-intensity white/light-gray pixels localized in speckle patterns and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-gray to black field across 90% of the visible surface area. High-intensity white point-clusters (stippling) are mapped to the lower-central and lower-left quadrant of the fluke. Textured brownish-white clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips (left and right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees and a high-depth bounding box relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serration across both lobes. A distinct secondary notch is visible approximately 40% along the left trailing edge from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves along the posterior trailing edges, terminating in sharp, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-density constellation of white circular stippling (approximately 20-30 discrete points) concentrated on the lower left ventral lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological colonization (barnacle clusters) present at both the left and right distal tips, significantly altering the smooth geometric perimeter of the fluke ends.
